title: Cassini Dove Into Saturn at 70,000 Miles Per Hour

scenes.text: A spacecraft dove into Saturn at seventy thousand miles an hour.
It was Cassini, and it had circled Saturn for thirteen years.
Its fuel was almost gone, so NASA chose how it would end.
A dead probe could have crashed into a moon that might hold life.
So Cassini kept sending data until it went silent, about nine hundred thirty miles above the clouds, then burned up.
Seventy thousand miles an hour, straight into Saturn.

description:
A spacecraft dove into Saturn at seventy thousand miles an hour.
NASA's Cassini had no fuel left, so engineers chose to destroy it instead of risking a crash into a moon that might hold life.
Would you have pressed the button?
first_comment: Would you have pressed the button to end Cassini, or let it drift?
